# Conformance suite for the Captain command language (docs/LANGUAGE.md).
#
# Each case is a line as typed, then "= " and its canonical parse tree
# (captaincode.Turn.String; `captain parse "<line>"` prints the same).
# A case whose tree starts with "(error" matches on the message's opening.
#
# Every change to how a line is read adds or edits a case here, in the same
# commit as the parser and the spec (docs/LANGUAGE.md, "Changing the
# language"). Never edit an expected tree to make a failing test pass
# without a spec change that says why the reading changed.

# Routing: a bare task, a forced leg, lanes, pools and skills

fix the login bug
= (auto "fix the login bug")

/grok fix the login bug
= (leg grok "fix the login bug")

/grok: fix the login bug
= (leg grok "fix the login bug")

/quality fix the login bug
= (auto [quality] "fix the login bug")

/q fix the login bug
= (auto [quality] "fix the login bug")

/save summarise the log
= (auto [save] "summarise the log")

fix the login bug /speed
= (auto [speed] "fix the login bug /speed")

/oss /deterministic fix it
= (auto [oss deterministic] "fix it")

/noslop write the release notes
= (auto [noslop] "write the release notes")

# /frontier: a head alone, a modifier before a leg or anywhere else

/frontier prove the bound
= (frontier "prove the bound")

/frontier /codex prove the bound
= (leg codex [frontier] "prove the bound")

/claude prove it /frontier
= (leg claude [frontier] "prove it /frontier")

# /team

/team audit the deck
= (team "audit the deck")

/team /quality audit the deck
= (team [quality] "audit the deck")

/oss /team audit the deck
= (team [oss] "audit the deck")

# OpenShell: a turn it leads runs whole in the sandbox, unless it is a chain

/openshell audit the bank export
= (openshell "audit the bank export")

/openshell scan > /claude fix it
= (openshell "scan > /claude fix it")

/team /openshell audit the ledger
= (openshell team "audit the ledger")

/openshell scan > /repeat 2 /quality fix it
= (chain (openshell "scan") (repeat 2 (auto [quality] "fix it")))

# Workflows (CWL): legs in sequence and in parallel

/grok analyse X > /codex review it
= (workflow (stage (leg grok "analyse X")) (stage (leg codex "review it")))

/grok analyse X then /codex review it
= (workflow (stage (leg grok "analyse X")) (stage (leg codex "review it")))

/grok analyse X -> /codex review it
= (workflow (stage (leg grok "analyse X")) (stage (leg codex "review it")))

/grok fix A + /cursor fix B
= (workflow (stage (leg grok "fix A") (leg cursor "fix B")))

/grok fix A and /cursor fix B
= (workflow (stage (leg grok "fix A") (leg cursor "fix B")))

/grok review X > /codex
= (workflow (stage (leg grok "review X")) (stage (leg codex "review X")))

/codex + /cursor + /grok what do you think
= (workflow (stage (leg codex "what do you think") (leg cursor "what do you think") (leg grok "what do you think")))

/codex implement it gate: go test ./...
= (workflow (stage (leg codex "implement it" (gate "go test ./..."))))

/frontier draft > /codex review
= (workflow [frontier] (stage (leg frontier "draft")) (stage (leg codex "review")))

# Chains: whole commands in sequence, groups nested behind >

/frontier write specs > /repeat 5 /quality implement them
= (chain (frontier "write specs") (repeat 5 (auto [quality] "implement them")))

/team audit it > /claude fix what it found
= (chain (team "audit it") (leg claude "fix what it found"))

/grok a + /codex b > /repeat 2 /quality merge
= (chain (workflow (stage (leg grok "a") (leg codex "b"))) (repeat 2 (auto [quality] "merge")))

/team plan > (/grok build > /repeat 3 /quality polish)
= (chain (team "plan") (chain (leg grok "build") (repeat 3 (auto [quality] "polish"))))

/team scope > (/grok draft + /codex draft > /claude merge)
= (chain (team "scope") (workflow (stage (leg grok "draft") (leg codex "draft")) (stage (leg claude "merge"))))

/repeat 3 (/frontier plan > /team build)
= (repeat 3 (chain (frontier "plan") (team "build")))

# /repeat: loops and their control words

/repeat 5 /quality implement the next item
= (repeat 5 (auto [quality] "implement the next item"))

/repeat check the feed
= (repeat until-stopped (auto "check the feed"))

/oss /repeat 3 check the feed
= (repeat 3 (auto [oss] "check the feed"))

/repeat
= (repeat-control status)

/repeat watch the queue
= (repeat until-stopped (auto "watch the queue"))

/repeat show
= (repeat-control show)

/repeat stop all
= (repeat-control stop "all")

/repeat show ch_1a2b3c
= (repeat-control show "ch_1a2b3c")

# /parallel and the control words that own their line

/parallel /grok scan the logs
= (parallel (leg grok "scan the logs"))

/parallel status
= (control parallel "status")

/btw also check the cache > /repeat 2 x
= (control btw "also check the cache > /repeat 2 x")

/wf save review /grok analyse > /claude audit
= (control wf "save review /grok analyse > /claude audit")

/wf compare three designs and pick one
= (control wf "compare three designs and pick one")

/run wf_abc123
= (control run "wf_abc123")

/captain more oss 20%
= (control captain "more oss 20%")

/private add acme
= (control private "add acme")

# Prose stays prose

check that x > y holds for all n
= (auto "check that x > y holds for all n")

compare /usr/bin/claude and /opt/homebrew/bin/claude
= (auto "compare /usr/bin/claude and /opt/homebrew/bin/claude")

/grok see /quality/report.md
= (leg grok "see /quality/report.md")

/frontier show (a) > (b) in the table
= (frontier "show (a) > (b) in the table")

# Errors

/gpt5 do it > /claude review
= (error "unknown leg /gpt5")
